subject: Procura vendor record & invoice / PO requirements
messages:
From: Procura AP <ap@procurahealth.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: maya.singh@procurahealth.com
Date: 2026-08-01T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor record request: Redwood Inference

Hi Naomi,

We're onboarding Redwood Inference into Procura's supplier master and need the vendor record details to proceed with PO issuance and automated invoice routing. Can you please supply the following so we can create your supplier profile in our system?

- Legal entity name and DBA
- Remit-to address and preferred invoice email
- ACH/IBAN details for wire (if available) and SWIFT/BIC
- Tax documentation (W-9 for US entities; VAT registration or EU self-cert for non-US)
- Default payment terms you accept (Net30/Net45/other) and whether you offer early-pay discounts
- Any required PO matching fields (e.g., PO number on invoice, cost center, project code)
- Preferred remit currency and whether you accept consolidated invoices per month

We also attach a copy of our PO template and the supplier setup checklist for your records. Would you be able to return the requested docs and confirm bank info by EOD Wednesday so we can issue a PO next week?

Thanks,

Procura AP Team
Procura Health Accounts Payable
ap@procurahealth.com

(attachment: procura-po-template.xlsx)

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Procura AP <ap@procurahealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor record request: Redwood Inference

Hi Maya / Procura AP — thanks for the note. Attaching our AP onboarding packet (pdf) and a redacted bank statement plus our completed W-9. See answers inline below and a few questions at the end.

- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (DBA: Redwood Inference)
- Remit-to email: invoices@redwood.com (please send PDFs to this address; we also support EDI and SFTP if preferred)
- ACH details: (attached) Redwood Inference, Inc. — routing/account (U.S. ACH). For cross-border wires we use SWIFT: RWDIUS33.
- Tax docs: attached W-9. For EU customers we can provide VAT self-cert / VAT number on request — we are US-headquartered.
- Payment terms: Standard Net30. We can discuss Net45 for enterprise contracts, and we occasionally offer a 2%/10 early-pay discount for agreed SOWs (requires a written addendum).
- PO matching fields: Please require the PO number to be present in the invoice header and, if possible, include "Procura PO#" in the invoice PDF meta. We also need a single line item per invoice that maps to our GL code (we can supply the GL on the invoice if you pass through a project code).
- Currency: We invoice in USD by default. We can issue EUR invoices if Procura prefers — please confirm FX handling and who bears conversion fees.

A couple of quick asks:
1) Can you confirm whether Procura requires an EORI number or VAT reverse-charge handling for any EU subsidiaries?
2) For automated validation, does your system accept invoices with embedded attachments (PDF + matching CSV) or do you require a flat PDF only?

I've cc'd Laura (Tax) and Ben (Payments) so they can supply the redacted bank file and handle any tax follow-up.

Best,

Naomi Feldman
Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
aomi_feldman@redwood.com
(attachment: redwood-ap-onboarding-packet.pdf, redwood-W9.pdf, redwood-bank-statement-redacted.pdf)

From: Procura AP <ap@procurahealth.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: maya.singh@procurahealth.com
Date: 2026-08-03T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor record request: Redwood Inference

Thanks Naomi — packet received and looks mostly complete. A couple follow-ups from our side:

- Procura requires the PO number on the first page and in the invoice filename (e.g., PO123456_invoice.pdf).
- Our system can accept a single PDF with attachments, but the top-level PDF must include the invoice summary (line items table) for matching.
- For EU entities: Procura is requesting a VAT reverse-charge self-cert from suppliers that are not registered in the EU. If Redwood will supply services to our EU subsidiary (Procura Europe), please confirm whether you can provide a signed EU VAT self-cert or if you'll register for VAT in-country.
- Regarding currency: Procura will pay in USD for US contracts. For invoices in EUR we require the supplier to indicate the gross-to-net FX conversion methodology on the invoice.

Last item: we have a one-off SLA exception for new technology vendors where we can issue an initial PO prior to completed setup if you provide a payee verification and two references. If you want to go that route we need confirmation and the two reference contacts.

Can you provide the VAT handling answer and confirm whether Procura should expect invoices named with the PO number in the filename? If yes we'll proceed with issuing PO-2026-0823 next Monday.

Best,

Maya Singh
Senior AP Analyst | Procura Health
maya.singh@procurahealth.com

(attachment: procurement-supplier-checklist.xlsx)
